title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while out and about with Curren Chan…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow, wow, wow! Look at all the plushies! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan points toward a claw machine filled with Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: …Hey. Don't you think a super cute plushie is just perfect for a super cute girl?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: …Hey. Don't you think a super cute plushie is just perfect for a super cute girl?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: If I had some of those with me, I think I'd be waaay cuter!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I can't wait to see how hard you'll work for me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I can't wait to see how hard you'll work for me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
